siteFaq.title: A few useful answers.
siteFaq.description: Clear details about profiles, campaigns, and working together on Wave.
siteFaq.answer1: Wave connects creators and companies through public profiles, campaigns, applications, and collaboration offers.
siteFaq.answer2: Creators can share their work and audience; companies can build a profile and publish campaigns.
siteFaq.question3: How does a collaboration get started?
siteFaq.answer3: Browse profiles or open campaigns. Companies can review applications and send an offer, then both sides agree on the details directly.
siteFaq.answer4: Not currently. Wave does not process payments; the creator and company arrange terms and payment directly.
siteFaq.answer5: No. Metrics are self-reported, and each one includes its last-updated date.
